card.name: The word not before recommended
card.fires_on: The word "not" right after "is" when the sentence is about to say "recommended". It appears in drug-label advice about co-administration, dosing or use with other foods or drugs.

modes.label: Co-use not recommended
modes.description: A statement that using a drug together with another drug or agent "is not recommended".
modes.example: Co-administration of etravirine tablets and other NNRTIs is<< not>> recommended.

modes.label: Dose or method not recommended
modes.description: A statement that a dose, schedule or way of giving a drug "is not recommended".
modes.example: Once daily dosing is<< not>> recommended.

card.writes: It pushes the model to output "recommended" and related words after "is not".
card.plain: It marks the spot in a label where the text says something is "not recommended".
evidence: Co-administration of etravirine tablets and other NNRTIs is<< not>> recommended.
